ShortDescription.Value: A WriteEverywhere-Module that replaces Vanilla Signs with Dutch ones.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Dutch Vanilla Theme Overrider ## SERIE A PACK Hallo and Hello. This is a Vanilla Theme Overrider that turns Vanilla Signs and Roadmarkings to Dutch ones. This Overrider uses the ANWB Font. Can be found [here](https://www.maisfontes.com/anwb-uu-regular.font).
---
## Requirements - [Write Everywhere](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/92908/Windows) – required
